reviews.text:
Thanks to D.O.G., my baby comes home happy every day after spending the whole day playing at the park. 🐶❤️

One of his favorite moments of the day is arriving at reception and being greeted with so much love. 🥹✨ Eli, Liz, Valerie, and Mirna have become like aunts to him, and he adores them. Thank you for loving him, spoiling him, and making him feel at home every day. 🥰

I’ve been taking my dogs to DOG Hotels Wynwood for years, and we’ve always had such a great experience! The staff is amazing, and my pups absolutely love going there. They also do a fantastic job with baths and nail trimming. My dogs always come home happy and smelling great!
In the heart of Wynwood the best Dog Hotel in South Florida
My dog Archie loves going in!! He is so excited and comes home tired but so happy. We love dog hotel!!

We love Dog Hotels Wynwood! The entire team always welcomes Rogelio with so much excitement, and he’s always so happy to stay. He absolutely loves going there to play, and it gives us so much peace of mind knowing he’s happy and well taken care of. Highly recommend!
Best doggy daycare in Miami! Eli and her staff are the sweetest. They care about my Rollie and Paddy as if they are their own. I wouldn’t take them anywhere else! Thank you DOG Wynwoosd!!

Had a great time with my dog Apollo at Wyn Dog Days today! Awesome event bringing green space and a future dog park to Wynwood. Well organized, fun atmosphere, and great community vibe. Looking forward to the next one! 🐾 …
